englishTranslation: Rice with caramelized fish in clay pot
atAGlance: Cơm cá kho tộ is rice with clay-pot caramelized fish. The dark fish-sauce caramel is meant to season the rice.
whatItIs: Cơm cá kho tộ is the rice-plate version of cá kho tộ, fish braised in fish sauce, caramelized sugar, and pepper.
howToEnjoy: Use plain rice to soften the salty-sweet sauce. Add pickles or greens for contrast.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm cá kho tộ when you want clay-pot caramel fish with rice. Ask about bones before the plate lands, and ask for extra rice if you like soaking up the fish-sauce caramel juices.
worthKnowing: This is a comfort-food order, especially in southern-style meals where braised fish and rice belong together. In Vietnam, rice plates are everyday meals shaped by broken rice, scallion oil, pickles, fish-sauce caramel, and quick street-service habits.
goodToKnow: Ask about bones if you prefer easier fish pieces. The fish-sauce caramel braise should be intense, not mild.
travelerCaution: May contain fish bones and fish sauce.
